Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
Despite service of notice, no one appeared on behalf of the complainant.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.12 of 2024, under Sections 376(2)(f) IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station Kotwali Tanda, District Ambedkar Nagar.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the applicant, who is the father of the victim used to commit wrong on her for the last one month.
In terms of the medical examination, the tentative age of the victim was assessed as 12 years.
Subsequently, the victim got recorded her statement before the trial court, wherein, she denied the involvement of the applicant and stated that a vendor has committed wrong on her.

sentences.text: 1 4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the said statement of the victim denying the prosecution story coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal antecedents and is languishing in jail since 20.01.2024, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Satish Verma be released on bail in the aforesaid first information report on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
